metadata.title: 90s R&B Group Portrait with Futuristic Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A three-person group portrait featuring a high-contrast cyan-to-black gradient background and custom futuristic chrome-effect lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of three women in a triangular formation, set against a vibrant cyan background that fades to black at the bottom. The foreground features a large, stylized, custom-lettered logo with a metallic chrome finish and sharp, sweeping terminals.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular group composition with central figure slightly recessed
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows on skin and clothing
Vibrant cyan background contrasting with dark leather and white cotton textures
Large-scale futuristic logo anchored in the lower-left quadrant
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome texture on primary display lettering
Sharp, elongated 'horns' or 'tails' on the custom typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the upper two-thirds of the frame in a tight, overlapping group shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, silver-white stylized logo in the bottom left corner acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down the white tank top of the right-most figure, and settles on the large logo and secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners of the cyan background.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (shadows, leather jacket, and bottom gradient)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with deep, crushed blacks in the foreground subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Continuous fluid strokes with varying thickness
Elongated, sharp, whip-like terminals extending horizontally
Chrome-like beveling and inner glow effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' features a wide, sweeping crossbar that extends over adjacent letters
The 'L' or end characters terminate in long, curved points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a complex, illustrative display logo and a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the secondary text's wide, geometric feel
Necessary for the primary logo's unique fluid/sharp hybrid style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three women in 90s streetwear (leather jacket, white tank tops, silver cross necklaces) against a cyan-to-black vertical gradient background with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom-drawn metallic chrome logo in the bottom left with sharp sweeping tails, and a small geometric sans-serif subtitle in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant cyan gradient?
Does the logo have a metallic, beveled chrome effect?
Are the logo terminals sharp and elongated?
Is the secondary text wide-tracked and clean?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the logo does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the cyan gradient is smooth without banding.
Check that the chrome effect looks reflective and 3D.
Confirm the secondary text is legible against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Group Portrait + Cyan/Black Gradient + Futuristic Chrome Lettering
